title: Aran's Discord Presence
description: A lightweight, customizable Discord Rich Presence mod for Fabric. Features a built-in settings menu to toggle Server IP, biomes, dimensions, and player heads on your Discord status.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe785f71d0b8b318c1136fd5806bad6768685123_0.webp)


# VERY IMPORTANT! ⚠️

**IF YOU HAVE MODRINTH OPEN, IT WILL OVERRIDE THE DISCORD ACTIVITY! 
REMEMBER TO CLOSE MODRINTH AFTER MINECRAFT LAUNCHED!**



## Intro! 

This mod gives you multiple options to have your minecraft activity on your discord account!


## Configs 🔨

- **3D Player Heads:** Shows your actual skin as a 3D head icon.
- **Server Icons:** Automatically shows the icon of the server you're playing on.
- **Singleplayer Info:** Shows your biome and gamemode when playing alone.
- **Settings Menu:** Change everything in-game via the Options > Discord RPC button.

## MUST HAVE

⚠️ _You need to have installed fabric and the discord app._


Most RPC mods are "all or nothing." They either show everything (including private server IPs) or they look very basic. Aran's Discord Presence is designed to be lightweight so it doesn't drop your FPS, while giving you the best-looking profile status possible.
